Contribute Across Layers: Develop features across the full stack, including web front-end features (Ember.js), when projects require it.
Own the Lifecycle: Take part in the entire development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and production monitoring.
Get Hands-On: Work directly with real access control hardware to develop, test, and debug device integrations.
Ensure Quality: Write unit and integration tests, validate features before release, and monitor production performance.
Balance Trade-offs: Exercise good judgment — know when to iterate quickly and when to build for scale, robustness, and maintainability.
Collaborate: Work closely with product managers, hardware/device engineers, and other software teams across time zones.
Grow and Share: Learn from senior engineers through code reviews, design discussions, and pairing — and share your own knowledge as the team grows.
Continuous Improvement: Bring your ideas! We want our engineers to collaborate on product development, not blindly build to a spec.

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
2+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C# is a plus.
Experience developing backend services and HTTP APIs (REST or similar).
Experience with database design and development (SQL).
Experience with creating and maintaining unit tests; familiarity with integration testing and CI/CD is a plus.
Familiarity with a modern JavaScript framework such as Ember.js, Angular, or React.
Experience working with hardware, IoT, or device development is a plus.
Good communication skills.

Why Work for Alarm.com?

Make an immediate impact — own projects that directly affect the businesses that rely on our security solutions every day.
Work with real-world IoT devices — see your code in action on the access control panels, readers, and locks we integrate with.
Be empowered — take ownership of features, drive technical decisions, and build best-in-class products.
Work with modern technologies — our stack includes C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, and native mobile applications.
Long-term employment based on a permanent employment contract (CoE).
Attractive benefits package — Medical care, life insurance, sports package, annual budget for professional development ($2,000).

, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Manager

__

Help shape the next generation of digital services at ABB Electrification Service Division. We are look-ing for a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems to unlock agentic AI capabilities across our digital port-folio and turn them into real customer value. In this role, you will help build intelligent systems that support customers in achieving their most important asset management goals: higher reliability, bet-ter predictability, greater availability, improved sustainability, and smarter lifecycle decisions. You will work at the intersection of AI, backend engineering, and enterprise integration to transform architec-tural designs into secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.

ABB’s digital and service portfolio is increasingly focused on customer experience, comprehensive as-set management, digital enablement, and sustainability outcomes. This role is a key enabler for trans-lating that portfolio direction into intelligent products and workflows that help customers reduce downtime, improve maintenance decisions, optimize operations, and extend asset life.

As a Senior AI Engineer – Agentic Systems, you will build, integrate, and operate production-grade AI agents and agentic workflows across ABB ELSE digital services. You will own the engineering required to move beyond pilots into secure, reliable, enterprise-ready solutions. This includes agent orchestra-tion, enterprise tool integration, evaluation, monitoring, control mechanisms, and operational excel-lence. The role also has an important team uplift dimension: you will mentor colleagues and help raise the internal bar in agentic AI engineering.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.
Turn solution designs into scalable, production-ready implementations across the ELSE landscape.
Connect agent workflows with enterprise platforms, operational data, APIs, and digital tools used in ELSE services.
Define effective patterns for tool use, context management, memory, orchestration, and workflow execution.
Create evaluation and validation approaches to ensure agent quality, safety, accuracy, and performance in real use cases.
Implement human approval flows, fallback mechanisms, and operational guardrails.
Ensure production readiness through testing, monitoring, deployment automation, and controlled releases.
Work closely with architects, product owners, data engineers, and software teams to deliver reliable, business-ready ELSE solutions.

Qualifications for the role :

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
7+ years of experience in software engineering, including designing and delivering enterprise-grade backend and cloud-based solutions.
2-3+ years of hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, LLM-integrated systems, or agent-based workflows in production environments.
Strong backend engineering skills, ideally in C#/.NET, with Python as a strong plus.
Strong experience with APIs, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and secure enterprise integration.
Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com
to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
co.brick talents
— powered by AI, powered by people. Software Development Engineer in Test

Stawka: 100 – 110 zł/h netto + VAT (B2B)
Model pracy: Zdalna (wymagana obecność na terenie Polski)
Długość projektu: 6 miesięcy (z możliwością przedłużenia, start: ASAP)
Wymiar pracy: Full Time (1.0 FTE)
Wymagany język angielski: min. B2/C1
Branża: Finanse / FinTech

O projekcie

Dołącz do zespołu budującego od zera ( greenfield
) kluczowy komponent nowego ekosystemu wspierającego procesy zarządzania wierzytelnościami. Projekt jest realizowany w podejściu Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
oraz metodologii Agile / Kanban
. System bazuje na architekturze rozproszonej, komunikacji asynchronicznej (event-driven) i architekturze mikrousługowej.

Ze względu na to, że jest to projekt greenfield, przed wdrożeniem produkcyjnym nie występują żadne zadania utrzymaniowe (no-legacy)
.

Projektowanie, tworzenie i utrzymywanie automatycznych testów (API, UI, e2e)

Testowanie systemów rozproszonych oraz integracji międzyusługowych bazujących na komunikacji asynchronicznej (kolejki, event-driven) i REST API

Utrzymanie traceability oraz zarządzenie testami w Jira + Xray
Monitorowanie kluczowych metryk (np. przepustowość płatności, opóźnienia przetwarzania) z wykorzystaniem Grafany

Wymagania podstawowe

Min. 4–5 lat doświadczenia w roli Testera / QA Engineera (w tym min. 2 lata na stanowisku Seniora)
Bardzo dobra znajomość programowania w C# / .NET oraz frameworków xUnit, Reqnroll, Shouldly
Praktyczne doświadczenie z narzędziami Cypress oraz Playwright
Znajomość narzędzi do testowania API: Swagger, Postman, Apidog, TestContainers
Doświadczenie w testowaniu systemów rozproszonych i architektury event-driven (komunikacja asynchroniczna / kolejki)
Doświadczenie w projektach realizowanych zgodnie z zasadami DDD (Domain-Driven Design)
Doświadczenie w pracy z GitLab CI/CD oraz GitHub Actions (tworzenie i modyfikacja pipeline'ów)
Dobra znajomość SQL (PostgreSQL), systemu kontroli wersji Git oraz narzędzi Jira + Xray
Umiejętność pracy z metrykami w Grafanie
Wykształcenie lub praktyka w tworzeniu testów BDD
Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie min. B2/C1
Lokalizacja w Polsce (warunek konieczny ze względu na politykę bezpieczeństwa sprzętu klienta)

Mile widziane

Znajomość Docker, Kubernetes, OCP (OpenShift)
Doświadczenie w testach wydajnościowych (np. JMeter, k6)
Znajomość technologii webowych (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Doświadczenie w wyznaczaniu standardów jakości oprogramowania oraz mentoringu młodszych członków zespołu
Otwartość na wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w codziennej pracy (GitHub Copilot, LLM)

jobs.title: Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Emerging technologies such as Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), cloud, artificial intelligence, and APIs, together with strategic trends such as ESG, have the potential to transform our industry. Euroclear aims to leverage these technologies and trends to develop products, services, and capabilities that address market inefficiencies and reinforce its role as a trusted market infrastructure provider.

The Innovation tribe within IT is responsible for delivering these digital capabilities across business lines and entities. To support its continued growth and ambitions, we are strengthening the team with a Test Automation Engineer who will work in a fast-paced, truly Agile environment.

The Test Automation Engineer will contribute to software delivery by designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests, while also supporting manual testing activities when required. The role is key to ensuring high-quality, reliable, and maintainable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborate with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear test scenarios and automated test cases.
Design, implement, execute, and maintain automated tests for API and web applications to validate functionality, performance, and user experience.
Support continuous improvement of testing practices, quality processes, and automation coverage within the Agile team.
Identify, report, and follow up on defects, working closely with developers to support timely resolution.

Your Qualifications

3–5 years of professional experience with C#, TypeScript, Java, or another object-oriented programming language.
Solid understanding of semantic HTML and CSS.
Good knowledge of API testing and UI test automation frameworks such as Playwright.
Professional experience using Git in a collaborative software development environment.
Strong understanding of software quality principles and how to improve quality processes.
Demonstrated experience working across the full software development life cycle within an Agile team.
Good knowledge of SQL.

Nice to have

Certification in software testing, such as ISTQB Certified Tester, or another relevant professional certification.
Experience with Microsoft Azure and DevOps practices.
Experience with Angular.
Experience with test-driven development.
Experience with continuous integration and continuous deployment practices.
Experience with AI-native development practices, including the use of AI-assisted coding, testing, and automation tools to improve engineering productivity and software quality.

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity and strives to be a Great Place to Work for All. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment, regardless of any aspect that makes them unique (including race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, pregnancy, disability, ...). If you need any specific accommodation due to disability or any other reason, you can let the recruiter know during your application process. Our values guide how we work together and shape our future: Our mission and values - Euroclear

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Want to know how a leading workplace experience and facility management company is powered by technology?

At ISS Tech Team, we create smarter workplace experiences through technology. Our Global Technology Solutions team builds digital solutions, from sensors and IoT devices to data, analytics and AI-driven capabilities, that support our ISS A/S operations across Cleaning, Workplace, Food and Technical Services.
With tech hubs in Copenhagen, Warsaw, and Porto, and teams collaborating across more than 30 countries, our ISS Tech team develops our digital solutions that have a real impact on both our customers and our people.

Location:
Warsaw, Poland
Work Regime:
Hybrid

What will you do as Solution Architect:

As a Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in shaping our organization’s technology landscape. You’ll collaborate with line-of-business stackeholders, assess existing solutions, and design future-state architectures. Your strategic insights will drive business process improvements and enable the adoption of cutting-edge technologies.

Designing System Architecture:

Developing concepts and designs for IT system architecture to meet business, performance, and security requirements.
Defining the structure of applications to be created or modified within a project.
Designing the integration methods between different IT systems.
Creating the initial system architecture as a starting point for further work.
Improving and optimizing existing system architecture in response to changing needs, including evaluating the current state of solutions and identifying gaps.
Designing database architecture.
Creating prototypes and solution skeletons, including recommending and developing design patterns and architectural standards.
Defining principles related to the software development process.
Designing systems in monolithic or distributed architecture.
Developing recommendations regarding specific system solutions, including for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and self-developed software.

Creating Solution Specifications:

Translating business and functional requirements into a technical design for the future system.
Defining detailed technical requirements for projects, including hardware environment, infrastructure, necessary software, selection of tools, and technologies.
Preparing project specifications and specifications for the technical environments needed for its implementation.

Developing Technical Documentation:

Creating conceptual and design documentation describing the system's architecture and operation, following the ISS Standards.
Preparing descriptions of the system's construction (design) solutions.
Documenting the technical parameters of the system.
Creating schemas, diagrams (e.g., UML), and technical drawings illustrating the architecture, data flow, or component operation.
Developing and updating procedures related to the designed system or architecture.
Describing the non-functional properties of the product/system resulting from the adopted architecture.
Defining the conditions of use and limitations for the designed solution.

Key qualifications:

Holds a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Systems Analysis, or a related field, or possesses equivalent practical experience.
Has 5 -10 years of professional IT experience, demonstrating the ability to think strategically and translate plans into operational excellence.
Possesses deep expertise and preferably some business knowledge in specific domains.
Experience with Cloud native development (preferably AWS/Azure), microservices, APIs (REST/GraphQL), OAuth/SAML and Patterns (e.g. event-driven, messaging).
Knowledge of various Integration patterns and IT Security best practices (OWASP) is a must.
Holds expertise across multiple technological domains, including Cloud, Automation, Software Development, Data, and AI.
Remains “evergreen” by actively keeping up-to-date with technology trends and emerging technologies.
Ability to communicate with, convince and inspire senior management, explaining findings and associated risks such that impact is clear and ownership is taken
Competence in creating comprehensive documentation for systems, processes, and integrations.
Strong skills in working with others, fostering a cooperative and productive team environment.
Proficiency in identifying issues and developing effective solutions.
Flexibility to adjust to new challenges and environments, and willingness to learn new skills.
Efficiently managing time and prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and achieve goals.

Why ISS:

At ISS, we are more than just a service provider of cleaning, food, workplace and technical services, we are a partner in our customers’ success. By creating exceptional service moments and transforming workplaces into spaces where employees feel valued, engaged and productive, we enhance productivity and help our customers to attract talent and grow their businesses. This begins with our own people through training, career development, and a supportive culture – empowering them to deliver outstanding service. We know that when our people thrive, they create spaces where our customers’ employees and businesses thrive too.

ISS is a Place to Be You.

Be who you are. Become what you want. Be part of something bigger.
Become more. Become ISS.

ISS seeks to BE a place of belonging and CREATE places where every person is welcomed, embraced, and valued for exactly who they are. Places where people feel safe, respected, represented, and supported as their authentic selves.

jobs.title: Web & Mobile Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nasz klient to doświadczona firma doradztwa technologicznego, działająca od 2010 roku i realizująca ponad 500 projektów. Specjalizuje się w strategii cyfrowej, projektowaniu UX/UI oraz tworzeniu aplikacji mobilnych, platform webowych i agentów opartych na sztucznej inteligencji. Firma pomaga klientom budować spójne ekosystemy cyfrowe, łącząc kreatywne podejście z solidnym inżynierskim wykonaniem. Oferuje elastyczne modele współpracy — zespoły projektowe, dedykowane oraz dostęp do specjalistów cyfrowych na żądanie — co pozwala dostosować tempo i strukturę pracy do potrzeb klienta. W zespole panuje kultura współpracy, nastawiona na jakość doświadczeń użytkownika i realne wsparcie biznesowe. Obecnie firma poszukuje ekspertów technologicznych: projektantów UX/UI, inżynierów aplikacji mobilnych, web developerów oraz specjalistów AI, którzy chcą współtworzyć zaawansowane produkty cyfrowe na nowoczesnych platformach. To atrakcyjne środowisko dla osób ceniących innowację, pracę zespołową i wpływ na kształtowanie rozwiązań cyfrowych dla klientów z różnych branż.

Web & Mobile Solution Architect

miejsce pracy: Gdańsk

Do Zadań Wybranych Osób Należeć Będzie

Analiza potrzeb biznesowych oraz wymagań funkcjonalnych i niefunkcjonalnych.
Projektowanie docelowej architektury rozwiązań, sposobu integracji, przepływu danych i komunikacji z systemami zewnętrznymi.
Projektowanie skalowalnych integracji, API oraz rozwiązań działających na wielu platformach.
Podejmowanie i uzasadnianie decyzji dotyczących technologii, frameworków, bibliotek i narzędzi.
Ocena wpływu decyzji architektonicznych na wydajność, bezpieczeństwo, utrzymanie, skalowalność i koszt realizacji.
Przygotowywanie dokumentacji architektonicznej, diagramów, standardów technicznych i rekomendacji dla zespołów.
Prowadzenie rozmów discovery z klientami i identyfikowanie rzeczywistych potrzeb, ograniczeń oraz ryzyk.
Prezentowanie proponowanej architektury, rozwiązań technologicznych i estymacji.
Wsparcie przygotowania ofert, estymacji, odpowiedzi na zapytania ofertowe i RFP.
Techniczne prowadzenie zespołów developerskich w całym cyklu życia projektu.
Organizowanie technicznej części Sprintu 0, w tym przygotowanie środowisk, repozytoriów, CI/CD, standardów kodowania, testowania i bezpieczeństwa.
Definiowanie oraz egzekwowanie standardów clean code, dobrych praktyk architektonicznych i zasad jakości.
Prowadzenie przeglądów architektury oraz wspieranie zespołu podczas code review.
Mentoring mniej doświadczonych członków zespołu oraz wspieranie ich w rozwiązywaniu trudnych problemów technicznych.
Identyfikowanie ryzyk technicznych i komunikowanie ich osobom odpowiedzialnym za projekt.
Współpraca z zespołami UX/UI, QA, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps i Delivery.
Wspieranie odpowiedzialnego wykorzystania narzędzi AI w procesie developmentu, testowania, przeglądów kodu i dokumentacji.
Dbanie o wysokie standardy bezpieczeństwa, ochronę danych i zgodność rozwiązań z wymaganiami GDPR.

Dodatkowy zakres odpowiedzialności

Projektowanie spójnej architektury rozwiązań obejmujących aplikacje webowe i mobilne.
Definiowanie granic pomiędzy frontendem webowym, aplikacjami mobilnymi, backendem, API i usługami chmurowymi.
Dobór technologii odpowiednich dla platform webowych, iOS i Android.
Projektowanie wspólnych mechanizmów integracyjnych, uwierzytelniania, przechowywania danych, monitoringu i bezpieczeństwa.
Modernizacja istniejących systemów oraz planowanie migracji rozwiązań legacy.
Wspieranie zespołów webowych i mobilnych w utrzymaniu spójnych standardów technicznych.

Wymagania

Minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w roli obejmującej odpowiedzialność architektoniczną lub techniczne prowadzenie projektów, np. Solution Architect, Software Architect, Tech Lead lub Senior Developer.
Wieloletnie, praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu i wdrażaniu aplikacji.
Umiejętność projektowania kompletnych rozwiązań end-to-end, a nie wyłącznie pojedynczych komponentów.
Bardzo dobra znajomość wzorców projektowych, clean architecture, zasad clean code oraz modularnego projektowania systemów.
Doświadczenie w projektowaniu API, integracji z systemami zewnętrznymi i rozwiązaniami backendowymi.
Znajomość procesów CI/CD, automatyzacji testów, code review oraz praktyk zapewniania jakości.
Doświadczenie z architekturą chmurową, np. AWS, Azure lub Google Cloud Platform.
Umiejętność oceny kompromisów pomiędzy wartością biznesową, czasem realizacji, kosztami i złożonością techniczną.
Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu technicznych warsztatów, spotkań z klientami lub prezentacji rozwiązań.
Umiejętność komunikowania zagadnień technicznych zarówno zespołom developerskim, jak i interesariuszom biznesowym.
Doświadczenie w pracy w metodykach Agile/Scrum.
Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego, minimum B2, umożliwiająca swobodną pracę z klientami i międzynarodowymi zespołami.

Wymagania specjalistyczne

Bardzo dobra znajomość architektury nowoczesnych aplikacji webowych i mobilnych.
Praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu aplikacji frontendowych, backendowych oraz mobilnych.
Doświadczenie w technologiach webowych, takich jak PHP, Laravel, React.js lub Vue.js.
Znajomość technologii mobilnych, takich jak Swift i SwiftUI, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native lub Kotlin Multiplatform.
Bardzo dobra znajomość REST API, integracji z systemami zewnętrznymi i projektowania usług backendowych.
Umiejętność projektowania skalowalnych rozwiązań opartych na architekturze chmurowej.
Dobre rozumienie różnic pomiędzy rozwiązaniami natywnymi, cross-platformowymi i webowymi.
Znajomość zagadnień bezpieczeństwa, wydajności, cache'owania, monitoringu, pracy offline i przechowywania danych.
Doświadczenie w modernizacji systemów, refaktoryzacji lub migracji rozwiązań legacy.

Zapunktujesz Dodatkowo Gdy Posiadasz

Doświadczenie w software house, agencji digital lub firmie realizującej projekty dla zewnętrznych klientów.
Praca przy projektach realizowanych w modelu fixed price.
Doświadczenie w tworzeniu proof of concept i technicznych prototypów.
Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi wspierających development przy użyciu AI.
Doświadczenie w projektach realizowanych przez rozproszone, międzynarodowe zespoły.

Oferujemy

Stabilną i długofalową współpracę w oparciu o umowę o pracę lub kontrakt B2B.
Model hybrydowy - pracę z biura w Gdańsku we wtorki i czwartki.

jobs.title: Solution Architect - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence (Warsaw or Poznan)
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Solution Architect in Roche Digital Technologies (RDT) - Biometrics and Clinical Evidence focuses on designing business-driven, standards-based, and future-ready solutions within the complex clinical trial and real world data acquisition domain, working across multiple systems in the end-to-end ecosystem. In this role, you will design solutions that meet product requirements, business priorities, and enterprise standards while managing non-functional requirements (NFR) and fitness functions.

You will lead others to solve complex problems, maintain the architectural vision and roadmap for multiple solutions, provide technical oversight to product teams, and evaluate new technologies including the rapidly growing Agentic AI and ML technologies to accelerate innovation and maximize the impact to the business.

Your Responsibilities

Jointly develop the IT Product roadmap together with the engineering teams and product heads and advise on technology choices
Design solutions that meet system requirements, business priorities, and fit within the overall CRF & RWD Data Acquisition ecosystem. Accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture design
Ensure compliance and alignment with the Roche enterprise standards, principles and policies
Assess functional & non-functional requirements and technical enablers together with Business Analysts and the technical team to develop architecture-runway and key design decisions
Documents and evolves the architecture throughout the product life cycle
Work closely with the development teams to resolve technical challenges during system development and support
Continually explore, research and pilot emerging technologies and propose adoption as appropriate
Identify cost-savings opportunities and optimize IT investments
Mitigate security and compliance risks from technical debt and obsolescence
Propose and lead proof of concepts (PoC) to assess technical viability together with the Tech team
Work with RDT adopting the use of AI and ML solutions in both developing and managing data pipelines
Actively participate & collaborate with solution, information, and enterprise architects within the engineering team and across products

Who You Are

You built 7+ years of work experience as a Solution Architect or Technical Lead, of which at least 4 years in the Life Sciences or Pharma Industry. Knowledge of Pharma Regulations (GxP, Computer Validation) experience preferred
Demonstrated experience designing business-driven, standards-based, future-ready solutions within a complex or multiple solution/product context
Experience maintaining the vision, roadmap, and current landscape for multiple solutions, and assessing the impacts of initiatives on capabilities, risk, and application landscapes
Proven track record of proactively contributing to architecture practices development and mentoring others
Experience in the Pharma/Biotech domain, especially Clinical Trial Data Systems, such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Non-CRF data systems, digital health technologies, and clinical data warehouses
Experience with ETLs/ELTs, data warehouses/lake/lakehouses, enterprise data integration patterns, relational and object databases, and experience with AWS or other cloud technologies
In-depth and expert-level knowledge in multiple technology areas
Proficiency in creating Conceptual & Logical Data Models, Taxonomies, Ontologies, and Integration pathways for products
Ability to define and drive reference architectures, patterns, NFRs, and fitness functions
Advanced capability to drive external technology trends and assess feasibility for multiple solutions, including conducting vendor assessments
Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to communicate difficult concepts and influence stakeholders to adopt different perspectives
Proactive mindset to identify opportunities to enhance value, improve existing solutions, manage technical debt, and lead teams in identifying innovative solutions
You are flexible and able to adapt to shifting priorities and commit to collaboration during "Roche Golden Hours" (4:00 - 7:00 PM CET Time)
You are fluent in English

Description Of The Area

This team is responsible for delivering software systems for the CRF and RWD acquisition and ingestion of Roche clinical trial data, serving as the source of truth across Roche Pharma. Foundational systems in this area include Roche’s Electronic data capture (EDC) - Medidata Rave, non-CRF systems, and clinical data warehouses.

These systems are critical to drug development, powering clinical data review, safety reporting, operational insights for clinical teams, and support early development activities in the Genentech (gRED) and Roche (pRED) Early Research and Development groups. They provide data to the Analytical Data Science’s ecosystems to standardize and analyze data for regulatory submissions. In addition, standardized clinical data from these systems are essential to integrate with Roche’s specialized data modality platforms including omics, clinical imaging, and digital health technologies.

A key focus in this area will be to leverage emerging AI technologies to optimize clinical data acquisition data pipelines. This includes enriching metadata and building AI-ready datasets to enable autonomous agentic and human-in-the loop AI systems which are transforming the drug development process.

#RDT2026

The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 228,900.00 PLN - 425,100.00 PLN. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 20% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package.

Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Du som vill väva in säkerhet i moderna utvecklingsflöden och se effekten hela vägen ut i produktion kommer att trivas här. Som DevSecOps Engineer på HiQ i Stockholm får du kombinera webbutveckling, moln och säkerhet i uppdrag där din kompetens märks varje dag.

Som DevSecOps Engineer hjälper du våra kunder att bygga säkra, robusta och moderna webblösningar från arkitektur till produktion. Du arbetar med backendutveckling, CI/CD-flöden, molnplattformar, containers och ser till att säkerhet finns med i varje steg. Du identifierar och analyserar säkerhetsrisker i webbapplikationer, genomför säkerhetsgranskningar, arkitekturanalyser och hotmodellering och är ett naturligt bollplank för både utvecklare och beslutsfattare. I många uppdrag är du drivande i att etablera eller stärka DevSecOps-arbetssätt så att snabba releaser och hög säkerhet går hand i hand.

Designa och implementera säkra backendlösningar för webb och APIer
Integrera säkerhet i CI/CD-flöden, Infrastructure as Code och molnplattformar
Arbeta med containers med särskilt fokus på säkerhet och driftsäkerhet
Identifiera, analysera och åtgärda säkerhetsrisker, till exempel kopplade till OWASP Top 10
Genomföra säkerhetsgranskningar, hotmodellering och arkitekturanalyser i kundernas miljöer
Stötta utvecklingsteam i att bygga in säkerhet tidigt i utvecklingsprocessen och följa upp effekten över tid

Vi tror att du har:

Teknisk utbildning inom till exempel cybersäkerhet, datateknik eller likvärdigt område
Cirka fyra års erfarenhet av webbsäkerhet och/eller DevSecOps-arbete
Erfarenhet av backendutveckling i till exempel Java, C#, Python, Node.js eller liknande språk
God förståelse för hur webben fungerar, inklusive HTTP, APIer, autentisering, auktorisering , OWASP Top 10 etc.
Erfarenhet av CI/CD samt Infrastructure as Code och av molnplattformar och container eller Kubernetes-miljöer med fokus på säkerhet
Vana att arbeta utifrån säkerhetsstandarder och riktlinjer som OWASP, ISO 27001, NIST eller CIS
Förmåga att förklara säkerhetsfrågor på ett sätt som fungerar för både tekniker och beslutsfattare, mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift, goda kunskaper i engelska samt svenskt medborgarskap

Meriterande är konsulterfarenhet och certifieringar som CSSLP, CKS, AWS eller Azure Security, CompTIA Security+ eller andra relevanta IT säkerhetscertifieringar.

Varför HiQ?

Hos oss möts säkerhet, utveckling och moderna arbetssätt i vardagen. Du arbetar i uppdrag där din kompetens gör tydlig skillnad, tillsammans med kollegor inom utveckling, moln, arkitektur, test och säkerhet som gärna delar kodexempel, verktygstips och erfarenheter. Vi uppmuntrar initiativ, oavsett om det handlar om att testa ett nytt verktyg i pipelinen, starta ett internt säkerhetsnätverk eller hålla en kunskapsdelning, och du får goda möjligheter att växa genom certifieringar, kurser, konferenser och interna forum.

Sedan 1995 har HiQ varit konsultbolaget som förenklar världen för både kunder och slutanvändare med hjälp av teknik, design och kommunikation. Vi har alltid haft två tydliga fokus: att ha roligt på jobbet och att leverera lösningar som överträffar förväntningarna – det är det som driver oss framåt. Som HiQare är vi stolta över en kultur som präglas av resultat, ansvar, enkelhet och glädje. Vi tror på att arbeta tillsammans för att nå gemensamma mål och vi lägger stor vikt vid att hjälpa varandra att växa och utvecklas. Hos oss får du inte bara möjlighet att bygga din egen kompetens, utan också chansen att lära, leda och inspirera dina kollegor.

The team is responsible for the tools used to capture and manage information about our customers' homes, supporting everything from home surveys and technical assessments to installation design. These products help ensure that the right information is available throughout the process, enabling tailored and efficient clean energy solutions.

You'll join a small, autonomous product team and work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and build scalable solutions that support Aira's continued growth across Europe.

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the products and services that power these workflows. You'll work across the stack to build scalable solutions and great user experiences.

Design and build applications and services that support users across multiple European markets
Develop scalable APIs and integrations with third-party systems
Process and manage data collected throughout the Survey & Design journey
Transform complex technical and geometric data into solutions that support our products and workflows
Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term evolution of the platform
Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and end users to improve workflows, user experiences and product capabilities
Explore new technologies and approaches that help solve real business problems

Around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer

jobs.description:
Overview

Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.

Attackers attempt to create billions of bot accounts daily on Microsoft platforms to perform phishing, spam and a variety of attacks. Attackers also run International Revenue Share Fraud (IRSF) against any public voice/SMS services. Our team builds both detections and blocking mechanisms against all the above attacks, in particular, focusing on fighting fraud. We constantly investigate the most advanced nation state attacks, and understand the latest techniques deployed by the most sophisticated attackers. We develop detections through training machine learning models, using threat intelligence signals as input, aggregated across entire Internet. We build state of the art machine learning platform for both training, deployment and monitoring. Our machine learning models protect billions of Microsoft users in real-time. With this team, you get a chance to learn new technology in AI, security, and distributed system design. We have experts in all these 3 areas to help you grow. We are looking for Software Development Engineers who is passionate about making an impact in identity protection and anti-fraud.

Our team has a strong sense of accountability and provides its members with many opportunities for learning and career growth.  We have exciting opportunities for you to innovate, influence, transform, inspire, and grow within our organization and we encourage you to apply to learn more! Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. jobs.title: Software Development Manager, Aurora Control Plane, Aurora Control Plane
jobs.description:
Description

Come join the growing RDS Aurora Serverless Control Plane team, innovating on behalf of our customers on a service that:

Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud native databases for our customers freeing them from traditional database operations
Guarantees best-in-class availability and failover capabilities to sustain the world’s most demanding workloads
Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of a database cluster from creation to operation to scale-up, scale-out and fail-over

Amazon Aurora Serverless Control Plane does all this and more. Amazon Aurora is a cloud-native relational database which combines the scalability and performance of the best NoSQL databases paired with full compatibility to the most popular relational open source databases - MySQL and PostgreSQL. Amazon Aurora can store petabytes of customer data and can handle peaks of millions of queries per second. As one of the fastest-growing services at the core of the AWS Cloud and also one of the largest managed database services in our business, your engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses depend on the scale and performance of Amazon Aurora and its control plane to support their mission-critical workloads. We continue to believe it is Day 1 for the Amazon Aurora business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to Amazon Aurora.

As a Software Development Manager in this role, you will own a core part of the Control Plane charter, responsible for Aurora Serverless v2 and its wide array of enterprise features.

You will work in a highly collaborative, diverse and engaging environment that attracts talent and provides ample opportunities to grow and learn. You will have the freedom to shape how the team works and what mechanisms and processes you want to establish to achieve the teams and organizations goals and deliver results to our customers. This role gives you the opportunity to have an impact on the future of Aurora and its future growth.

In this role you provide technical direction and guidance to the team you are working with. Our engineers know that building a control plane to manage large scale cloud native databases is fun and challenging. It is not just any distributed system. It is a system orchestrating a distributed storage engine operating with petabyte scale data sets, real-time node failure detection mechanisms, multi-datacenter and cross-continent replication. You will coach junior and intermediate members of the team to become established contributors to our service by providing interesting and aspirational projects and mentoring them to successfully complete them. You will collaborate with senior engineers to work on large and complex features that have impact across different teams in the organization and high value for our customers.

You will also work directly with our customers to gather feedback and understand their use-cases. Together with the Aurora leadership this will help you to shape a vision for the team and define and align roadmap and deliveries with our product management. You will lead the delivery of new features both customer-facing and improving operational and technical efficiency of the solution. You will have an impact on our new offerings by taking advantage of your knowledge of industry trends and engineering tradeoffs and your ability to listen and understand the customer. You will be a thoughtful steward of existing systems, appropriately challenging assumptions and driving change when necessary to allow us to scale for growth.

This is a hands-on position in which you will be asked to show ownership. If you are technically knowledgeable and a good collaborator and communicator that can lead with empathy for our customers and engineers, then this is for you. We don’t need you to be an expert in databases. You will have a chance to learn on the go. We rather appreciate curiosity and craftsmanship over knowledge in specific technologies. At the same time you will benefit from interacting with many of the talented people within AWS and they will help you improve and expand your management and technical skills on a daily basis.

Aurora is part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

The role encompasses people, product and project management together with technical leadership. As a manager within the team, you will have opportunities to set the teams’ roadmap, and to work closely with support teams, senior engineers and other managers within the Amazon Web Services (AWS) organization.
The position involves manager on-call responsibilities, one weekend every 3 months. We don’t like getting paged, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant and that our alarms are well calibrated. When we do get paged, we work together to first mitigate and then resolve the root cause so we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
Grow and foster talent from Junior to Senior devs on a daily basis
Establish mechanisms to efficiently run the team and help prioritize and balance the backlog
Work with PM and other engineering teams on roadmap strategy and prioritization
Share updates to the leadership team on the teams deliverables
Review designs and help shape the teams design documents
Manage and drive the operational ownership of the team

About The Team

Team is focused on customer dev experience and often operates across the org, closely working with Aurora Serverless, Aurora Storage, Aurora Platform teams.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
Experience in engineering team management
Experience in engineering
Experience in leading the definition and development of multi tier web services
Experience partnering with product and program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Fullstack Engineer

Help us create the software platform that will change Norwegian healthcare forever.

The mission

We're building the healthcare platform all Norwegians deserve — an integrated set of services that lets institutions, clinicians, social workers, and citizens collaborate as a single team. We want every person in Norway to enjoy the longest, happiest life possible. That means improving the everyday lives of healthcare workers, giving patients more control, and maybe saving a few lives along the way.

It doesn't get more meaningful than that.

The Teams

Team Patient

Crafts Mitt Aidn — our portal and mobile application serving as the daily digital doorway connecting citizens, families, and municipal care providers.

The problems the team is working on right now:

Rolling out a consumer-facing native app with biometric login and instant push notifications, transforming standard web access into an essential daily companion.
Crafting fine-grained consent models that balance parental rights for minors with automated confidentiality protections for teenagers.
Replacing paper-heavy processes by converting legacy paper authorizations into streamlined mobile sign-offs.

Team Case Handling

Empowering municipal caseworkers with a unified toolkit to navigate the entire lifecycle of care management — from initial intake and smart dispatch, through tailored service decisions and ongoing follow-up, all the way to secure archiving.

The problems the team is working on right now:

Giving case handlers a single, role-aware view — patient overview, tasks, care plans, notifications and search across all departments.
Building a way to route incoming applications and messages to the right case handler based on workload, competence and location
Piloting AI-assisted case handling to improve decision quality and save caseworkers time — laying the groundwork for broader adoption in 2027.

Team Collaboration

Focuses on planning and optimisation — an area defined by complex algorithms, dense data, and a genuine obsession with giving health workers the best possible conditions to do their jobs.

The problems we're working on right now:

How do we manage home services staff, competencies, and schedules without a robust workforce system integration?
How do we organise and execute treatment plans collaboratively across different disciplines of care?
How do we build route plans that account for variable-length visits, driver skills, and multi-driver coordination — not just geography?
Can our solver run fast enough to keep planners in the loop, rather than disappearing for 10 minutes in the background?

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
jobs.description:
Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.

Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.

We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data-driven, product-first organization powered by a small, tight-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes*.

If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!

Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

Why This Role is Exciting

Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.

This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.

Responsibilities And Duties

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high-performing, scalable and user-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.
Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.
Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.
Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.

Backend & Fullstack Support

Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C#.
Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front-ends to our backend systems.
Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third-party services.
Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.

Architecture & Collaboration

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.
Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.
Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team to ship a best-in-class product, fast.

Code Review, Mentorship & Innovation

Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.
Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

What You Bring to the Table

5+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.
Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.
Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.
Hands-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).
Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high-ownership team.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

AI-Assisted Development

Proficient with AI-assisted and agentic software development tools such as Claude Code — or able to become proficient very quickly — using them effectively for coding, codebase exploration, refactoring, debugging, testing, code review and engineering automation.
Comfortable designing workflows where AI agents can safely perform or accelerate repetitive engineering tasks, while applying appropriate review and engineering judgment.
Actively explores new AI-assisted development practices and helps establish effective patterns for using them across the team.

Why Join Comtech?

Take real ownership of a product used by travelers around the world.

Work in an innovative, fast-paced environment where your work truly matters.
Get access to leading AI development tools, with their use encouraged as part of the normal development workflow — we're building a modern, highly productive small engineering team.
Flexible work arrangements at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.
Enjoy the same great staff travel benefits as employees across Norse Atlantic Airways.
Join a dynamic and international team building the future of airline travel.

This position is located at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.

jobs.title: Software Development Consultant (early career)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow not only as a software developer, but also as a trusted advisor? At Columbia Road, we're looking for talented developers to help businesses grow while you grow your career. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

Benefits

A monthly gross salary of 3000-4500 euros, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. In addition, we offer extensive benefits:
A community-led organisation with a high level of autonomy
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
Option to buy stocks of the company through the common employee share program
Recurring training and learning sessions to support your professional growth
Regular mentoring with a Roadie of your own choosing - or several!
Offices in downtown Helsinki (with gym and pool) and Tampere
A wide selection of quality tools to use for your work (laptop, phone etc.)
Extensive health care services, including dental and mental health
Insurance for travel and free-time
Lunch benefit
Phone subscription benefit
Weekly breakfasts and healthy daily refreshments
Flexible sports, culture, commuting and massage benefit
Recurring Roadie-ideated events and activities
Childcare services when your child falls ill
A possibility to book the office for private events during the weekends
Compensation for working on open source or social programs in your free time

We help companies sell better by building seamless digital solutions and running concrete growth activities. Find your Road with us by exploring open jobs or Connecting with us!

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Accessibility
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy. <span data-ccp-props="{"335559685":144,"335559731":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559991":144}"> 

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow. <span data-ccp-props="{"335559685":144,"335559731":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559991":144}"> 

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work. <span data-ccp-props="{"335559685":144,"335559731":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559991":144}"> 

What we will be doing

Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

Lead the people.  Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

Stay hands-on enough to be credible.  Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

Coach the team in AI-assisted development.  Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted.  Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

Partner with Product and Design as equals.  Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

Work across teams.  Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

Protect engineering health.  Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

Own quality and operational responsibility.  Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States.  This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

Perform other duties as assigned 

What we will require of you

Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

A real software engineering background.  You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest.  Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

Modern cloud and delivery practice.  AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle.  You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

Strong partnership with Product.  A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

Clear written and spoken English,  and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

Willingness to work a shifted day.  Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.  

What we will love about you

Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

Experience in a compliance or regulated environment,  such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

Open-source stewardship.  We build and maintain an open-source accessibility rules engine, and experience running a public project and its community is valuable.

Large-scale data or crawling systems,  document processing, or machine learning applied to content analysis.

Experience leading a distributed or multi-site team,  including working effectively with contractors and vendor partners.

Having introduced AI-assisted development to an organisation,  including the governance, measurement and change management that goes with it.

Danish language skills  are a nice-to-have and are not required; our working language is English.  

What you'll love about us
We’re building the next generation of AI-powered content intelligence, helping organizations unify accessibility, SEO/AEO, analytics, and content performance into one platform. If you’re energized by solving complex problems, working cross-functionally, and contributing to a product with real-world impact, we’d love to connect.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

As part of our team, you'll contribute your expertise in intricate systems, deciphering code, and anticipating software behaviors to ensure Applied remains the leader in the semiconductor and display sectors.

Role Summary

We are developing a manufacturing data and applications platform to support digitalization and automation across the organization. The role begins with building the foundational data layer—designing databases, pipelines, and system integrations—and progressively expands into developing business logic, backend services, and user‑facing applications on a modern manufacturing app platform. This position is well‑suited to an engineer who has demonstrable experience delivering production web applications to internal users, is comfortable working close to operations, and is eager to grow into a full‑stack role spanning data engineering, backend/API development, and front‑end application development.

Responsibilities

Data Foundations & Engineering
Design and evolve a maintainable relational or structured data model suitable for hierarchical manufacturing data.
Build and maintain data ingestion and transformation processes.
Establish reliable technical integrations with manufacturing applications, including:
Understanding source data structures and interfaces
Implementing stable connectors for recurring data acquisition
Handling schema or data format changes
Setting up integrity checks, alerting, and automated recovery
Backend & Business Logic Development
Develop backend services that implement core business logic for manufacturing business process flows.
Collaborate with solution and application developers to translate requirements into actionable business logic design for prototyping.
Build and maintain APIs or service endpoints used by downstream applications.
