Description

The Amazon Web Services Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking an experienced Clinical ProServe Cloud Architect (PCA) to join our team in Europe. In this role, you'll work directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences customers, including senior technology and business leaders, to understand their business objectives and translate them into innovative cloud and AI solutions that drive meaningful impact in pharmaceutical innovation.

As a PCA, you'll be responsible for creating and leading solution designs to address customer business outcomes (CBO) in the pharmaceutical domain. Operating as the conduit between ProServe Account Executives and our Shared Delivery Teams (SDT), you'll ensure proposed solutions are realistic, achievable, and optimized to maximize CBOs. You'll lead cloud modernization and AI transformation initiatives, designing scalable AWS solutions that address complex clinical development challenges including clinical trial management, clinical data operations, regulatory submissions, and study lifecycle optimization from protocol design through database lock. Your experience in designing technical solutions within the pharmaceutical sector will equip you to architect complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet specific customer needs, translating technical concepts into business value. Your success will be linked to impacting SOW signings and successful solution implementations that achieve CBOs while exceeding customer satisfaction (CSAT) expectations.

As a trusted technical advisor, you'll provide guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and agentic AI applications specific to pharma. You'll collaborate with expert teams including our Gen AI Innovation Center, Industry Sales, and Product teams to bring leading-edge innovation to customers. As a technical SME, you'll share knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable tools such as demos, accelerators, and white papers.

Key job responsibilities

Design scalable, secure AWS solutions that deliver measurable customer business outcomes across HCLS development lifecycle.

Provide technical guidance during sales and implementation phases, focusing on pharmaceutical domain challenges including clinical data management, regulatory submissions (eCTD), study conduct optimization, and GxP compliance.

Partner with customers on industry trends and emerging technologies, particularly agentic AI applications in clinical trial automation, clinical data standardization (CDISC SDTM/ADaM), electronic data capture (EDC), and clinical trial management systems (CTMS).

Collaborate with Account Executives and Delivery Teams to ensure successful solution implementation.

Work with AWS experts and external partners to accelerate innovation.

Share knowledge through coaching, demos, accelerators, and technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of cloud architecture, designing and implementing cloud solutions.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related field, or equivalent experience.
4+ years of deep technical experience in designing, solutioning, and building data platforms, AI/ML and /or GenAI solutions to achieve customer business outcomes
Experience managing and delivering large-scale enterprise IT projects, including hands-on experience, across Data, AI/ML, Application modernizations, or GenAI
Experience in presenting technical solutions to customer stakeholders and executive, including ability to translate complex technical architectures into business value propositions and strategic roadmaps that align cloud modernization initiatives with clinical development transformation objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience architecting enterprise-scale clinical/commercial data platforms with proficiency in multi-agent orchestration frameworks, clinical data integration patterns (API-based, batch ETL, real-time streaming), and cloud-native data lake/lakehouse architectures, demonstrating ability to articulate how agentic AI transforms clinical operations through intelligent automation of study planning, site activation, patient recruitment optimization, clinical monitoring, and regulatory submission workflows.
Achieved AWS Professional level certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, and AWS Certified Generative AI Developer – Professional or AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty) preferred.
Deep understanding of AWS services across compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies.
Knowledge of security and compliance standards (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
Expertise in performance optimization and cost management for cloud environments.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences as part of pre-sales motion.

Join N-iX and become part of a team where your ideas make a real impact.

At N-iX CTO Group
, we harness the power of technology to drive innovation and deliver exceptional business value. We specialize in designing and executing industry-relevant solutions that redefine standards in enterprise technology. Join a vibrant team committed to driving large-scale transformation across global enterprises.

As a Principal Solutions Architect
, you will play a key leadership role in shaping technology direction, guiding cross-functional initiatives, and enabling high-impact delivery. You’ll be responsible for leading complex solution engagements, from discovery and advisory to implementation, while mentoring architecture talent, strengthening practices, and contributing to company-wide strategic growth.

This role is ideal for a seasoned architect with strong consulting capabilities, a track record of hands-on project delivery, and the ability to scale architectural impact across multiple teams and accounts.

Strategic & Leadership Responsibilities:

Lead architecture visioning and cross-cutting strategic initiatives across a portfolio of enterprise clients.
Drive practice growth by establishing frameworks, methodologies, and reusable assets for solution delivery and consulting engagements.
Build and mentor architecture and engineering teams, ensuring capability uplift and technical excellence across accounts.
Act as a trusted advisor to client C-level executives and technology leaders, helping shape digital strategy and technology roadmaps.
Govern architecture implementation across the portfolio to ensure alignment with best practices, maintainability, and long-term value.

Delivery & Consulting Responsibilities:

Lead or guide discovery phases, assessments, technical workshops, and architecture audits.
Translate complex business and technical requirements into scalable, sustainable architectural solutions.
Own solution proposals during pre-sales and upsales, including technical vision, high-level design, risk management, and cost estimation.
Lead project execution, ensuring architecture is delivered according to vision.
Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, aligning client needs with forward-thinking architectural approaches.
Act as a Chief Architect and lead a team with subordinate architects on the complex accounts.

Qualifications:

10+ years of relevant experience in software engineering and solution architecture.
3+ years in an architecture leadership or principal-level role within the IT service / IT consulting environment.
Proven ability to lead complex, high-impact consultancy engagements with global enterprise clients.
Demonstrated experience building solutions from scratch, preferably for large-scale distributed systems (team size 30+, duration 12+ months).
Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, with hands-on experience in at least two major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
Strong background in microservices, APIs, integration patterns, and distributed system design.
Track record of coaching, mentoring, and team enablement within a matrixed or consulting environment.
Exceptional stakeholder engagement and communication skills—equally comfortable with engineers and executives.
Fluent in modern delivery practices: Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, etc.
English - Upper-Intermediate or Advanced

Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert)
Domain-specific expertise in areas such as data platforms, security, or enterprise integration is a plus

jobs.title: Software Engineer (.NET)
jobs.description:
Your next opportunity starts here.

At Aubay Portugal, we work daily with some of the largest organisations across sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications and energy, helping to build and evolve critical systems that support millions of users. We have been in Portugal since 2007 and are part of an international group with a presence in several European countries. More than technology, we build close relationships and deliver real-impact projects.

What will you do?

Develop and maintain critical enterprise applications using C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Framework / .NET 8).
Contribute to the implementation of scalable and modular architectures, applying Clean Code, CQRS, and Repository patterns.
Design and implement event-driven architectures utilizing messaging tools such as RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus.
Participate in frontend development with Angular or Blazor, and optimize service integration through Backend for Frontend (BFF) architectures.
Develop and optimize SQL queries, manage SQL Server databases, and oversee database migration processes.
Implement robust authentication and authorization mechanisms, while contributing to API design, versioning, and documentation with Swagger/OpenAPI.

What are we looking for?

At Aubay, our focus is on professionals who bring both technical expertise and the right mindset:
Proven experience in C# and .NET development, with recent exposure to .NET 8 and strong knowledge of SQL Server, including database migrations.
Solid hands-on experience with Event-Driven Architecture, CQRS, and Backend for Frontend (BFF) patterns.
Demonstrable experience with messaging tools such as RabbitMQ and Azure Service Bus.
In-depth, operational maturity with the Azure ecosystem, including Azure Service Bus, Key Vault, App Registrations, and Azure DevOps.
Experience with containerization technologies (Docker/Kubernetes) and a strong commitment to code quality, unit, integration, and automated functional testing.
Fluent Portuguese and very good English are mandatory, along with excellent soft skills, a collaborative mindset, and a desire for continuous learning in complex environments.
Alignment with our corporate culture and a commitment to integrity and ethics are highly valued.
Strong customer focus, teamwork, task prioritisation, and daily commitment are highly appreciated.

What can we offer?

At Aubay, we invest in your development and well-being:
Continuous growth through our Training Academy, with technical and soft skills training, mentoring, tech communities, workshops and in-person meetups;
Close support with regular feedback and a structured career advancement model;
Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage, as well as access to a mental health platform and well-being initiatives;
Team-oriented environment, including events and initiatives to promote connection and team spirit;
Personal and family life support, from the moment your children are born and throughout their educational path;
Access to a language platform with conversational classes in multiple languages;

jobs.description:
Challenge yourself and us

At AdvanceWorks, we learn together, grow together, and have fun together. And we do all this while creating great software solutions for clients across many industries and geographies.
We are constantly challenging ourselves and each other to use the latest technologies and the best methodologies and make sure we walk the talk.

About the project

You will join a public digital healthcare programme for a client in one of the Nordic countries. The work focuses on digital solutions used in the public healthcare sector, including interfaces built for healthcare staff and clinical specialists in their daily clinical work.
Depending on the client's needs, you may work across several of the client's initiatives or on a specific project. In both cases, you will work with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders towards clearly defined objectives, as part of a wider effort to support digital transformation and the client's strategic goals in healthcare.
Accessibility, security, and data protection are central to the project. The solutions follow WCAG 2.2 A and AA, apply security-by-design principles to defend against the OWASP Top 10, and handle medical record information under strict data protection rules. The interfaces connect to documented REST APIs with OpenAPI definitions and run on cloud-native platforms built to scale horizontally.
On the frontend, the technology stack follows one of two routes: .NET 8+ with ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or React 18+ with strict TypeScript. Code quality is managed through a defined development handbook, and the team uses artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.

What will be your role

We are looking for a Frontend Developer to build accessible, secure, and reliable interfaces for healthcare professionals in a public digital healthcare setting.
You will work either with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript, depending on your background. Your work will turn clinical and business needs into interfaces that healthcare staff can rely on, with accessibility, security, and data protection built in from the start.
You will work closely with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders, connecting your interfaces to documented REST APIs and contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling. You will also take ownership of defined work packages, deliverables, and decisions, and may act as a point of contact with stakeholders for the parts of the solution you lead.
The role is fully remote from Portugal, with occasional trips to the client once or twice a year. Experience with healthcare projects is especially valued, as it gives a strong understanding of the context these interfaces are built for.

Your responsibilities will include

Developing frontend interfaces for healthcare staff and clinical specialists.
Building and releasing solutions with .NET 8+ and ASP.NET Razor and/or HTMX, or with React 18+ and strict TypeScript.
Applying strict TypeScript settings, including strict mode, noImplicitAny, strictNullChecks, and exactOptionalPropertyTypes, when working on the React route.
Implementing WCAG 2.2 A and AA accessibility requirements throughout project delivery.
Applying WAI-ARIA labelling and carrying out screen reader testing.
Integrating with documented REST APIs using JSON and OpenAPI definitions.
Using automatic code generation based on OpenAPI definitions.
Contributing to cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling.
Applying resilience patterns such as retry and circuit-breaking.
Applying security-by-design principles and defending against OWASP Top 10 and CWE vulnerabilities.
Making sure information security and data protection requirements are met, including the handling of medical record information.
Ensuring code quality with the tools defined in the project's development handbook.
artificial intelligence in software development in a responsible and structured way.
Working with cross-disciplinary teams and stakeholders towards defined objectives.
Taking ownership of defined work packages, deliverables, and technical decisions.
Acting as a point of contact with stakeholders and leading improvements in your area of the solution.
Contributing to digital transformation initiatives and the client's strategic objectives in healthcare.

What should you bring to the team?

Postgraduate or specialist university-level education in computer science or software engineering
More than 3 years of combined experience with .NET 5+, including development and release with .NET 8 or later, plus experience with ASP.NET Razor (not WebForms) and/or HTMX; or
Experience with React 18+ in strict mode, along with experience in TypeScript v6+ and more than 2 years of combined experience with TypeScript v5+.
Experience with cloud-native solutions designed for horizontal scaling.
Knowledge of resilience patterns in cloud programming, such as retry and circuit-breaking.
Proven experience applying WCAG 2.2 A and AA in project delivery.
Experience with WAI-ARIA labelling and screen reader testing.
Experience with documented REST APIs using JSON, OpenAPI definitions on all endpoints, and automatic code generation.
Experience with security-oriented design and defences against the OWASP Top 10.
Knowledge of security-by-design principles and CWE.
Experience in information security and data protection.
Familiarity with the guidance issued by the Data Protection Authority on data protection and the handling of medical record information.
Knowledge of and experience with a commonly used code quality tool.
Experience building interfaces for healthcare staff or clinical specialists is valued.
Experience with healthcare projects is a strong advantage.
Experience working in cross-disciplinary teams with different team members and stakeholders towards defined objectives.
Experience taking or leading projects that supported digital transformation or strategic objectives
Ability to take responsibility for work packages, deliverables, or decisions, and to deliver results independently.
Experience leading part of a system or solution, guiding its direction, or acting as a point of contact with stakeholders.
Knowledge of and experience with the responsible and structured use of artificial intelligence in software development.
Authorisation to work in the European Economic Area.
Availability to work remotely from Portugal, with occasional trips to the client once or twice a year.

What is in it for you

An amazing informal culture of smart, hardworking, and friendly people who support and care about each other.

jobs.title: C# .NET Developer | Business Delivery Solutions
Senior Fullstack Developer – .NET Core / Angular / React
jobs.description:
Company Description

At Bosch, we shape the future by inventing high-quality technologies and services that spark enthusiasm and enrich people’s lives. Our promise to our associates is rock-solid: We grow together, we enjoy our work, and we inspire each other. Welcome to Bosch.

Job Description

As a Senior Fullstack Developer
, you will shape and develop internal digital products supporting HR, Purchasing and Engineering processes at Bosch. You will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, turning complex business needs into scalable, secure and user-friendly applications.

You will have a strong influence on architecture, technology choices and development standards while exploring how AI-enhanced development and agentic AI solutions
can take automation to the next level.

For the right candidate, the position also offers a clear opportunity to grow towards a Lead Developer role
, taking increasing responsibility for technical direction, architecture and mentoring.

Your tasks:

► Designing and developing scalable, secure and high-performance web applications using .NET Core / C#, Angular and React

► Creating digital solutions that automate and improve HR, Purchasing and Engineering processes, including innovative use cases with agentic AI

► Making and contributing to architectural decisions across backend, frontend and data layers

► Designing and developing APIs, microservices and data solutions using PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server and MongoDB

► Supporting cloud-native deployment and operation using Docker, Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure

► Exploring and integrating AI-enhanced development tools and automation solutions
to improve productivity, software quality and development efficiency

► Mentoring developers, performing code reviews and contributing to development standards and best practices

► Collaborating closely with Product Owners, business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective digital solutions

► Taking ownership throughout the software lifecycle, including development, deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting and continuous improvement

Qualifications

► BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Informatics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

► 5+ years of professional software development experience
, preferably in fullstack development

► Strong hands-on experience with .NET Core and C#
, including backend services and API development

► Strong knowledge of Angular / TypeScript and/or React
and modern frontend development practices

► Strong experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server
, including database design, SQL and query optimization

► Good understanding of REST APIs, microservices, authentication and authorization
, as well as modern software architecture principles

► Experience with agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban

► Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills with the ability to solve complex technical challenges

► Proactive mindset, strong ownership and willingness to influence technical decisions

► Excellent collaboration and communication skills in multidisciplinary and international teams

► Professional working proficiency in English

What gives you further advantages:

► Experience With MongoDB Or Other NoSQL Databases

► Knowledge of Entity Framework Core
or similar data-access technologies

► Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and Microsoft Azure

► Knowledge of Git, CI/CD and automated testing

► Experience with AI-assisted software development, automation frameworks or agentic AI solutions

► Experience with productive software operations, monitoring, troubleshooting and maintenance

► UX/UI knowledge and interest in creating intuitive digital products

► Previous experience in mentoring developers or taking technical leadership responsibilities

► German language skills

Additional Information

Get to know our benefits.

We would like to help you GROW
, so we offer you:

Financial security & recognition: We review and increase your competitive base salary annually, offer performance-, loyalty-, and referral bonus.
Trainings and professional development: We believe in a Life-Long Learning approach, so you can take advantage of several technical and soft skill trainings and language courses.
Career development: We have a wide range of programs to choose from, even if its leadership, expert or project development you are aiming for. We also offer mentoring and coaching opportunities, we have PhD program and we offer international assignment possibilities.

We would like you to ENJOY
the benefits of balancing your life and your work, so we pay attention to:

Your work life-balance: You can work from our activity based offices designed for creativity and efficiency or from home while enjoying flexible working hours. We offer childcare possibilities and sabbatical option.
Your health and well-being: We provide free professional consultants for any personal, legal, financial or health related issues. You can benefit from our developing onsite medical center and organized regular health checkups.
We also offer you several perks and benefits: You can use your annual cafeteria allowance flexibly for family support (e.g. tax-free kindergarten and nursery allowances), health care, mobility (car sharing services) and recreation. You can enjoy our onsite canteen, we support when you work from home and if you live far, we cover your commute costs. We also appreciate your loyalty with jubilee gift and extra jubilee holiday.

You could join
an INSPIRING
community worth to belong:

We are true to our values: We are committed to sustainability, we value that everyone is different and that diversity makes us truly successful. We also take social responsibility seriously and regularly organize charity actions, blood donations and support worthy causes.
Team building activities and community events are also part of our everydays. We like to come together for a good summer party or family day.

Are you ready to work ?

Please apply with your English CV!

If you have any questions regarding the position or the application process, we encourage you to first visit our FAQ section [HERE], where you may already find the answer you're looking for. If you still need assistance, please feel free to contact us at the following email address - talentacquisitionhungary@bosch.com- We'd be happy to help.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer - DBO
jobs.description:
Shift4 (NYSE: FOUR) is boldly redefining commerce by simplifying complex payments ecosystems across the world. As the leader in commerce-enabling technology, Shift4 powers billions of transactions annually for hundreds of thousands of businesses in virtually every industry. For more information, visit www.shift4.com.

What You Will Do. A Glimpse Into Your Role

As a .NET & Angular Developer, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of modern in‑house DBO applications. You will play a key role in delivering high‑quality, secure, and scalable technology solutions that power Global Blue’s Tax‑Free Shopping products.

Working closely with your Development Lead and collaborating daily with Product, QA, UX, and DevOps, you will be part of a mature agile environment where engineering excellence, ownership, and collaboration shape the team’s success.

You will develop a deep understanding of our systems and be involved in every stage of the Software Development Lifecycle—from design through deployment and ongoing operations.

Every action has an impact. You will make a difference here if you:

Design and evolve scalable, maintainable services and web applications with clarity, simplicity, and long‑term sustainability in mind.
Apply Clean Architecture and clean coding practices daily; uphold SOLID, KISS, and YAGNI principles in both your work and peer reviews.

mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit C# .NET, fundierten Kenntnissen in Microservice-Architekturen, Containerisierungstechnologien und Prozessautomatisierungsplattformen, kombiniert mit solidem Bildungshintergrund und kollaborativer Denkweise.

Vertraut mit Versionskontrollsystemen (Git)

Erfahrung im Design und der Implementierung von Integration Connectors
Analytische und lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise an Problemstellungen
Angetrieben von der Bereitschaft zu wachsen und dich und dein Team kontinuierlich dazu zu bringen, innovative Ideen zu erkunden

new_jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
new_jobs.description:
Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.

Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.

We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data-driven, product-first organization powered by a small, tight-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes*.

If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!

Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

Why This Role is Exciting

Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder-to-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.

This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.

Responsibilities And Duties

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high-performing, scalable and user-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.
Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.
Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.
Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.

Backend & Fullstack Support

Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C#.
Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front-ends to our backend systems.
Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third-party services.
Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.

Architecture & Collaboration

Take ownership of end-to-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.
Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.
Collaborate closely with a cross-functional team to ship a best-in-class product, fast.

Code Review, Mentorship & Innovation

Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.
Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

What You Bring to the Table

5+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.
Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.
Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.
Hands-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).
Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third-party services.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high-ownership team.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

AI-Assisted Development

Proficient with AI-assisted and agentic software development tools such as Claude Code — or able to become proficient very quickly — using them effectively for coding, codebase exploration, refactoring, debugging, testing, code review and engineering automation.
Comfortable designing workflows where AI agents can safely perform or accelerate repetitive engineering tasks, while applying appropriate review and engineering judgment.
Actively explores new AI-assisted development practices and helps establish effective patterns for using them across the team.

Why Join Comtech?

Take real ownership of a product used by travelers around the world.

Work in an innovative, fast-paced environment where your work truly matters.
Get access to leading AI development tools, with their use encouraged as part of the normal development workflow — we're building a modern, highly productive small engineering team.
Flexible work arrangements at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.
Enjoy the same great staff travel benefits as employees across Norse Atlantic Airways.
Join a dynamic and international team building the future of airline travel.

This position is located at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.

Here's a taste of what life in Arendal and Southern Norway has to offer:

www.visitsorlandet.com

www.gotoarendal.com

www.welcomehub.no

www.businessregionkristiansand.no

If you're ready to take ownership of our app and help build something that matters in the airline industry, we'd love to hear from you!

We believe that culture will be our competitive advantage.

Team Norse has identified three core values that we all should live and breathe.

They are:

Be inclusive
Take ownership
Show kindness.
